request.description:
Route payment files into Agicap in any standard banking format. Once imported, the files are processed and sent to the bank without any modifications.
Supported Formats: the API supports all standard banking formats in `.xml` and `.txt` **Required OAuth scopes:** - `agicap:public-api` - `public-api:import_payment_files`

response.name: The remittance has been successfully imported.
